messages:
Elena: Dropping a fresh mock for the Roles panel toolbar and Audit section. Goals: reduce horizontal weight, clarify SSO enforcement language, and make audit filters easier to find. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc (frame: roles-panel-v2).

Ravi: Nice direction. Question: if we collapse 'Invite' + 'Bulk CSV' into an overflow, will admins miss it? Could we show a subtle badge count on the overflow when pending invites exist? :eyes:

Priya: Accessibility: if we hide labels at wide sizes, ensure buttons have aria-label and visible focus ring. Also modal opener needs aria-haspopup and aria-expanded toggles.

Jon: SSO toggle copy seems ambiguous. My suggestion: use `Enforce SSO login for all members` and add a secondary line: `Disables org passwords. Managed via Security → SSO.` That should reduce the "where do I configure this" questions.

Kai: Audit UX: strongly prefer a sticky filter strip above the table. Current UX hides filters after paging. Also prefer ISO date format for timestamps `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm` in the table.

Elena: Implementation notes I want on the ticket: - Responsive: full labels < 800px, icon+label >= 800px, icon-only >= 1400px with tooltip and keyboard hint. - Tooltip should show shortcut if available (e.g., `Invite (i)`). - Toasts should include an explicit "Undo" when people toggle SSO enforcement.

Ravi: On "Assign" vs "Grant" — I think "Assign role" is clearer for non-admin audiences. Can we do a quick copy sweep?

Priya: Quick ARIA snippet proposal to add to the PR description:
```
<button aria-label="Invite members to organization" aria-haspopup="true"></button>
```
Also add `role="dialog" aria-modal="true"` on modals and focus trap logic note.

Jon: One more microcopy: replace "SSO enforcement" with "Require SSO sign-in" in settings paths. Less abstract.

Kai: Keyboard nav idea: add `g a` to jump to Audit, and `g r` to jump to Roles. Low cost and huge quality-of-life for power users. Queue as a follow-up.

ux-bot: NOTE: Added a11y checklist to the prototype comment: focus order, aria-labels, contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for small icons, keyboard-only flows for CSV upload. Prototype updated -> roles-panel-v2a.

Elena: Nice. Action items for me: 1) Update figma with sticky filter row + ISO dates 2) Swap copy to "Assign role" and "Enforce SSO login for all members" 3) Add rollback UX to the SSO toggle toast 4) Link aria snippet in PR template. I'll post the new link when done. Thanks! :thumbsup:
